BBTTCC Heritage (v1.1, RFI-native). Human heritage: Cro-Magnon.

“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says stop.”

Human (Cro-Magnon). You are not a fantasy human. You are the cognitive, symbolic, cooperative inheritance of the lineage that first painted ancestors on cave walls, buried its dead with flowers, and traded ochre across a continent it had no map for.

Where Neanderthal is strength and Florensis is reach, Cro-Magnon is pattern. Language, ritual, coalition. You are the human branch that kept explaining things until the explanation started working.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Human).
  • Size. Medium.
  • Movement. 30 feet walking.
  • Lineage Lean. Human does not grant fixed attribute bonuses; your background handles increases. Your heritage leans toward Mind or Presence in fiction and through Tier powers.

Human Core: Stubborn Spark

At character creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory) from the Human species root.

Cro-Magnon Traits

  • Symbol Fluency. You know one additional language at creation. You can identify the emotional intent of any spoken or written communication in a language you know with a successful Presence (Empathy) or Soul (Insight) check; on a success, the GM tells you what the speaker actually meant, even if the words were not it.
  • Coalition Instinct. When you use the Help action on an ally's check and they succeed, the ally also recovers 1 point of Stress. The fiction matters: name the thing you said or did, even if it's wordless.

Strategic Hooks (Foundry / BBTTCC)

  • OP Edge. Your faction gains +2 Soft Power OP and +1 Intrigue OP at campaign start.
  • Hex Synergy. In Settlement / Market / Council hexes, your faction's recruitment, diplomacy, and propaganda operations cost 1 fewer OP (minimum 0).
  • Coalition Call. Once per Strategic Turn, your faction may convert up to 1 Violence OP and 1 Economy OP into 2 Soft Power OP, representing a coalition-building action: a speech, a shared meal, a joint ritual. The swap is narrated, not just accounted.
